art_direction: Late-1990s hand-drawn military cel aircraft with restrained naval-grey value groups, amber squadron marks, blue-grey canopy depth and warm turbine cores.
camera: Exact orthographic top-down, nose-left master; runtime reverses the pass only through the existing draw transform.

mastered.process: EVAVO Art Studio transparent-object finish; ensure alpha, guarded trim, normalize, sharpen and pad

review.notes: Canopy, twin engines, navigation lights and squadron marks remain readable across the live intercept and banked breakaway passes.
